subject: test fails in toolbox - Login incorrect after ansible_agnostic created the user
body:
## Observation
openQA test in scenario `microos-Tumbleweed-DVD-x86_64-container_host@uefi-2G` fails in
[toolbox](https://openqa.example.org/tests/600#step/toolbox/40): the tty login as the test
user says "Login incorrect".

ansible_agnostic runs first and creates the test user with `useradd -m` and no password;
toolbox only sets the password when the user does not exist yet.

## Reproducible
Fails since Build 20300923 in every run where ansible_agnostic passed (4 of 7).

## Expected result
Last good: Build 20300922 (https://openqa.example.org/tests/590), still on console/ansible.

## Suggestions
- Create the test user with its password in the ansible_agnostic wrapper
  (`ensure_testuser_present`), as console/ansible did.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1:** container_host passes toolbox after a passing ansible_agnostic.
notes: Searched openqatests subject and description for 'toolbox' and 'Login incorrect': no open ticket.
